title: The Mysterious Forest
setting: A dark and enchanted forest filled with magical creatures.
plotPoints: The knight hears rumors of a treasure hidden deep within the forest.
The fox offers to guide the knight but has its own agenda.
The tree spirit warns the knight of the dangers that lie ahead.

title: The Lost City
setting: An ancient city buried under the sands of time.
plotPoints: The archaeologist discovers a map leading to the lost city.
The journalist doubts the existence of the city and follows for a story.
The local guide knows secrets that could change everything.

title: The Time Traveler
setting: Various points in history, from the Renaissance to the future.
plotPoints: The scientist invents a time machine but accidentally brings a cat along.
They meet a famous historical figure who needs their help.
They must return to their time before the machine breaks down.
